skill.name: kuaishou-trend-insights
skill.description: Review Kuaishou hot-search rankings and keyword-based video samples using SocialDataX. Separate observed signals from ideas for content planning and brand research.
skill.summary: Summarize Kuaishou rankings and video search samples with traceable evidence.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most scanner alerts are Markdown formatting, public reference links, or text entropy; the CLI workflow does run an unpinned npm package that can access credentials. The shell examples lack safe argument handling, and the workflow does not require approval for requests that can spend credits. No evidence of embedded API keys or audit-directed prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned package execution during setup and research
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version in the installer and examples, verify its integrity, and replace automatic downloads with an explicitly approved setup step.

remediation.issue: Shell interpretation of search terms or continuation tokens
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and continuation tokens as literal arguments through an API that does not invoke a shell, or use structured MCP tool inputs.
Use a least-privilege key and an operating system credential store where available. Limit which process receives the secret and keep credential values out of logs.

remediation.issue: Credit spending without a user-approved limit
remediation.suggestion: Confirm a request budget before paid calls. Count pagination, retries, and requests resumed after a top-up against that budget.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted search values may reach a shell
semantic_findings.description: The preferred CLI example places a user-derived keyword in a Bash command. Continuation instructions also reuse service-supplied tokens as CLI input. Building shell text from either value can allow unintended local command execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The Bash template quotes the keyword but gives no safe argument-passing rule. Exploitability depends on whether the agent constructs shell text or passes literal arguments.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic follow-up requests can spend additional credits

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Balance and recovery rules show that queries can consume credits, even though users handle top-ups themselves. No credit approval step is specified.

content.value_statement: A hot-search ranking does not show whether a topic fits your audience. Compare ranking signals with relevant video samples and keep the source details behind each observation.
actual_capabilities: Fetch the current Kuaishou hot-search list without a keyword.
Search Kuaishou videos by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP connection.
Limit CLI video search by page count or item count and continue from a returned token.
Summarize rankings and heat signals separately from video search results.
Retain available video links or IDs, authors, and visible engagement for review.
limitations: Live retrieval needs working SocialDataX authentication through the CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Search has no guaranteed complete result set, and requested limits may not be reached.
A current ranking is a snapshot and does not establish historical growth or audience demand.
Research calls may consume credits. The skill does not log in to Kuaishou, post, react, or modify an account.

prompt_templates.title: Read the hot-search list
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the first five entries on the current Kuaishou hot-search list. Include the rank, topic, and heat signal when available.

prompt_templates.title: Sample videos for one keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [keyword] and review one page. Include relevant titles, authors, and links or IDs when available. Separate observations from ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Compare rankings and search evidence
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare two sources without mixing them.
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the current Kuaishou hot-search list and search for [keyword]. Use separate sections for ranking signals and video samples. Explain what each source does and does not support.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded evidence brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Collect a traceable sample within a budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [keyword] using a reviewed connection. Confirm the credit budget before paid calls. Stop at two pages or ten videos, whichever comes first. Include links or IDs, note partial results, and separate evidence from recommendations.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Summarize the leading Kuaishou hot-search entries.
output: Rank 1: Weekend meal prep. The list shows a higher heat signal than the next entry.
Rank 2: Small kitchen storage. The ranking is a snapshot, not evidence of growth over time.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Search for balcony gardening and identify a content idea.
output: Sample: One video demonstrates container herbs. Another compares plants for sunny and shaded balconies.
Evidence limit: This sample shows two formats. It does not show which format is more popular across Kuaishou.
Idea to test: Compare two starter plants under different light conditions.

best_practices: Use a verified MCP connection or a reviewed, pinned CLI version. Keep API keys out of chat and transcripts.
Start with one page and set a credit or request limit before retrieving more.
Keep rankings separate from video samples and cite available links or IDs for observations.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the current ranking as proof of long-term growth.
Do not restart from page one automatically after a partial response or a balance error.
Do not insert raw search terms or pagination tokens into shell command text.

faq.question: Do I need to supply a keyword for the hot-search list?
faq.answer: No. Use a keyword for video search, not for the current hot-search list.

faq.question: How do I authenticate?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or configure the CLI in the environment where it runs. Do not share the key in chat.

faq.question: Can requests consume credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Set a budget before requesting multiple pages. If the balance is insufficient, stop and review the account before resuming.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every result for a keyword?
faq.answer: No. Search has no guaranteed complete boundary. Use a page or item limit and label the results as a sample.

faq.question: What should I do when results are incomplete?
faq.answer: Keep the results already collected and mark them as partial. After resolving the error, continue only with a valid token and within the original limits.

faq.question: Can it post, like, or comment on Kuaishou?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow reads trend and search data without changing your Kuaishou account.
